lines.text: Built for ninety Martian days, Opportunity kept going for over fourteen years.
This light is its real route, from NASA's records. In 2005, a sand dune trapped it for more than five weeks.
At Esperance, its arm ground into a rock, then read what it was made of: clay minerals, from gentler water.
In June 2018, a dust storm blocked the Sun. The solar-powered rover fell silent.
Echoes of the Cosmos. Follow the whole journey.
